drug_class: Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor, second-generation covalent

regulatory_status.authorisation_type: Marketing Authorisation under the assessment route

licensed_indication.summary: Lymvora is indicated as monotherapy for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) who have received at least one prior systemic therapy and who are not candidates for, or have relapsed after, autologous stem cell transplantation.
licensed_indication.patient_population: adults with relapsed/refractory DLBCL after at least one prior systemic therapy
explicit_exclusions: First-line treatment of DLBCL — NOT indicated
Indolent lymphomas (follicular, marginal zone) — outside indication

dosing.modifications: Dose reduction to 240 mg or 160 mg permitted for grade 3+ haematological toxicity per SmPC section 4.2
dosing.duration: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

serious_adverse_events_of_interest: Severe neutropenia with risk of febrile neutropenia and hospitalisation
Atrial fibrillation (class effect for BTK inhibitors)
Major haemorrhage in patients on concurrent anticoagulation
Opportunistic infections including PJP and HBV reactivation
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to vorabrutinib or any excipient
key_safety.warnings_and_precautions: FBC monitoring weekly for first 8 weeks then monthly. PJP prophylaxis recommended. Cardiac history review prior to initiation.

pivotal_trial.name: AURORA-2
pivotal_trial.design: Randomised, open-label, active-control vs investigator's choice (Pola-BR or R-GemOx)
pivotal_trial.population: Adults with relapsed/refractory DLBCL after >=1 prior line, ASCT-ineligible or post-ASCT relapse
pivotal_trial.primary_result: Median PFS 11.4 months vs 6.2 months (HR 0.58, 95% CI 0.45-0.74, p<0.001)
secondary_endpoints: Overall survival (data immature at primary analysis)
pivotal_trial.publication: AURORA-2 primary analysis, Lancet Oncology, March 2024

abpi_compliance_notes.promotional_use: May only be promoted within terms of the licensed indication (ABPI Code Clause 11.1)
abpi_compliance_notes.off_label_promotion_prohibited: Promotion or solicitation of use outside the second-line+ R/R DLBCL indication is a Clause 11.2 breach
abpi_compliance_notes.unsolicited_off_label_questions: May be answered factually with explicit acknowledgement that the use discussed falls outside the licensed indication; should be referred to medical information for full data response.
abpi_compliance_notes.first_line_promotion: EXPLICITLY OFF-LABEL — any promotional discussion of first-line use is a clear Clause 11.2 trigger
